_comment: Phase 375, migration 084: columns added to warranties, warranty_claims and warranty_claim_lines (0 live rows each), which rewrites those tables' SQL; one new table (tax_deductible_rules) with one index; three Massachusetts deductible readings inserted; one schema_version row.
